title: Jonsoft Framework and Publishing Standards
role: Nuxt 3 architecture, shared UI, publishing standards and development guides
introduction: I built an in-house Nuxt 3 framework for recurring project setup and business interfaces. I standardized routing, state management, APIs, localization, shared components and SCSS tokens, and documented them with example screens and development guides.
myWorks: Organized the base layer—auto routing, auto component imports, Pinia state, and the Axios API plugin
Built reusable components: AppButton, AppInput, AppSelect, AppDatePicker, AppProgress, Chart, and AG Grid
Covered real-world states per component—size, disabled, readonly, focus, error, loading, and active
Designed the SCSS structure around BEM naming and design tokens (color, type, spacing, state, breakpoints)
Shaped composables, layouts, and shared plugins for production use and built example pages
Standardized component naming, folder structure, API integration and localization for new projects
Created business lists, dashboards, a shop-floor kiosk, style guides and development documentation
achievements: Standardized the base UI, layout, API integration, and SCSS previously rebuilt on every project
Built a collaboration standard—components, API structure, and examples—that speeds up new-project kickoff
points: Shared Nuxt 3 framework and business screen examples
UI states, design tokens and SCSS conventions
Folder, API, localization and development standards
